purpose: Teach: クリティカル/全会/総局/複写/扶桑社/スポークスマン/図版/中味

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文のクリティカルな部分を強調しろ
lines.en: Ren, emphasize the critical sections of your paper.
lines.style: Measured, direct. Clear authority without sharpness. A brief pause before the instruction—not cold, but purposeful. Expects compliance, respects his capability.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会の全会一致決議に注目しております
lines.en: Yes. I'm focusing on the conference's consensus findings.
lines.style: Respectful nod in the voice. Steady pace, careful enunciation. Shows he's listened and understood. Slight lift at the end—confirmation more than question.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、海外研究機関の総局とも連携しろ
lines.en: And coordinate with the overseas research institutions as well.
lines.style: Same steady authority as before. The 'and' carries a sense of building, not overwhelming. Specific but not micromanaging. A man giving someone he trusts a complex task.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究データの複写管理を徹底します
lines.en: Understood. I'll ensure strict oversight of the research data sharing.
lines.style: Formal but warm. Shows thoroughness without defensiveness. Slight emphasis on 'strict'—he's grasped the importance. The tone says: you can count on me.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、扶桑社系の出版社にも論文を売り込め
lines.en: Ren, reach out to Fusosha publishers about the paper as well.
lines.style: The same composed authority. A slight lean into the instruction—this one matters, he's trusted Ren with it. No urgency in the voice, but quiet weight.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室スポークスマンとして広報します
lines.en: Yes. I'll present it on behalf of the lab.
lines.style: Steady, professional. A touch of pride in 'behalf of the lab'—he's understood he's representing something larger. Clear and ready. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の図版を読者向けに整えろ
lines.en: Make sure the figures in your paper are reader-friendly.
lines.style: Final instruction, delivered with the same calm authority. A slight softening here—not directive, almost collaborative. 'Make sure' is gentler than the others.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の中味を再検討します
lines.en: Yes. I'll review the paper's content once more.
lines.style: Respectful close. Thoughtful pace. Shows he understands this is final polish, not new work. The voice settles—ready to conclude, assured.
